title: "Call You Back" by Sargeant and Comrade
htmlContent:
Sargeant and Comrade put the culture on notice of their unique commanding style in the new release "Call You Back." The music doesn't waste a single second grabbing you in and makes every aspect of the record count to confirm it for the listener. The song "Call You Back" is made with dusty old vinyl samples mixed with Yolanda's silky smooth vocals that take you on a journey to that golden place where music is sweet.

The queen of Lo-fi soul, Yolanda Sargeant, comes together with her producer, Comrade, to create a fantastic record that has not been heard in a long time. A record titled "Call You Back." It is a project filled with the camaraderie and lyrical prowess that has made Hip-Hop legendary.
